column1: # Known --posix divergences that are NOT Bash++ leaks.
# Every id here is a PRE-EXISTING bash-5.3 fidelity defect in the engine,
# present before any extended grammar existed and owned by the certification
# workstream, not by Bash++. They are listed so the cert-safety gate can stay
# green for its actual purpose — catching extended grammar reaching the
# certification profile — instead of being red from birth and therefore ignored.
# This is an allowlist, NOT a silence: --posix-gate still prints every one on
# each run, and it FAILS if a listed id stops diverging, so a fix tightens the
# gate instead of leaving a stale excuse behind for a real leak to hide in.
